nodes.name: API Reference.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive API reference for Setura Hospital OS edge functions covering REST endpoints, webhooks, authentication, authorization, request/response schemas, error handling, rate limiting, idempotency, and Supabase Realtime integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Qoder wiki page documenting all API categories: booking lifecycle, payments, messaging, and operations.

nodes.name: Authentication APIs.md
nodes.summary: Authentication and authorization behavior for Setura Edge Functions, covering JWT bearer token validation, multi-tenant hospital isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), and Supabase Auth integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents auth middleware, CORS handling, JWT extraction, profile/role resolution, and rate limiting.

nodes.name: Booking APIs.md
nodes.summary: Booking management API documentation covering appointment creation with conflict detection, capacity validation, full booking lifecycle states, cancellation policies, rescheduling rules, and status update workflows.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents create-booking, cancel-booking, reschedule-booking, and update-booking-status endpoints backed by SQL RPCs.

nodes.name: Communication APIs.md
nodes.summary: Communication API documentation for WhatsApp messaging, automated patient reminders, and delivery status tracking, including webhook ingestion, message queuing, and retry mechanisms.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents WhatsApp webhook handler, outbound message sending, reminder scheduler, and background worker integration.

nodes.name: Payment Processing APIs.md
nodes.summary: Payment processing API documentation covering Razorpay gateway integration, payment order creation, verification via webhooks, refund handling, and settlement engine for financial reconciliation.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents create-payment-order, verify-payment, process-refund, and settlement-engine endpoints with idempotency guarantees.

nodes.name: Queue Management APIs.md
nodes.summary: Queue management API documentation covering real-time patient flow operations including token allocation, queue position updates, priority rules, WebSocket live updates via Supabase Realtime, and background worker notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents queue advancement, booking status transitions, Supabase Realtime subscriptions, and job queue integration.

nodes.name: Webhook Endpoints.md
nodes.summary: Webhook endpoint documentation for WhatsApp webhooks and system health monitoring, covering signature verification, payload validation, retry mechanisms, dead letter queue handling, and audit logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents process-whatsapp-webhook and monitoring-health-check endpoints with idempotent webhook registration.
